title: apps/billing-service uses getRepository() in usage-aggregator, create-invoice, subscription handlers — tenant isolation bypass in financial code
rule_violated: CLAUDE.md "getRepository() is FORBIDDEN → use getScopedRepository()" — especially severe in billing because cross-tenant leakage = wrong invoice to wrong tenant.
notes: Financial correctness depends on tenant scoping. Audit each callsite against billing.subscriptions / billing.invoices schema (ADR-011).
